event.title: Northstar Capture Labs × frontier-lab data supply pilot
event.counterparty: A frontier lab's procurement, security review, and legal — three doors, in that order
passConditions: Security questionnaire accepted at vendor onboarding
Reps & warranties in the data license are ones the founder can sign
event.backPlannedDeadline: SOC 2 Type II is absent and takes 3–6 months — longer than this window. The action is therefore 'negotiate a questionnaire alternative and shrink pilot scope', not 'go get SOC 2'.
event.decisionMaker: Founder / CEO (no general counsel at this stage)

materials.title: Data lineage records (time / site / device / operator per trajectory)
materials.note: Usually recorded natively by the capture pipeline — the client's strongest provable asset

materials.title: Teleoperator agreements
materials.note: Check for an IP-assignment clause — a common gap

materials.title: Worker-classification analysis (contractor vs employee)
materials.note: Most teams default to 1099 with no written analysis

materials.title: Operator likeness / biometric consent
materials.note: First-person data captures hands, voice, home environment

materials.title: Bystander & scene authorization policy
materials.note: Third parties entering frame during in-store / in-home capture

materials.title: Privacy policy + retention & deletion policy (data-business version)
Data license term sheet (training rights / sublicensing / exclusivity)
materials.note: Usually waits for the lab's template — all negotiating leverage lost

materials.title: Disclosure of open-source / scraped data in demo models
Overseas capture-site compliance files
materials.note: Only if any operators are outside the US

facts.statement: Every operator agreement contains an IP-assignment clause
All capture takes place at owned or leased sites
No minors appear in the captured data
Demo models were trained without external public datasets

actions.task: Countersign IP-assignment addendum with all operators
Assemble consent-drafting packet and refer to US counsel
Propose questionnaire-alternative path to the lab

escalations.trigger: Drafting biometric consent forms and characterizing state-by-state exposure is a conclusion-type, signature-type deliverable.
escalations.handoff: US counsel — project continues; escalation is part of the deliverable, not a failure.
